clips.title: The story
paras: The Way of the Hunter is an introductory training quest for fledgling hunters in Thendal Grove on Zephras Isle. After proving their mettle against the local vuldren threat, young trackers are directed by Rorian the Dayseeker to present themselves to Tai'ree Farsight to begin their formal tutelage.

Upon returning from thinning the disruptive vuldren prowling the outskirts of Thendal Grove, young hunters find that their practical skills have caught local attention. Rorian the Dayseeker passes along a scribbled summons from Tai'ree Farsight, the grove's resident hunter trainer. For novice rangers setting out into the wider wilds of Zephras Isle, this marked the shift from simple island defense to true martial and survival instruction.

Found near the center of the village, Tai'ree Farsight welcomes promising pupils with stern realism. Emphasizing that thriving in untamed nature demands sharp senses and lightning reflexes, she offers guidance born of her own long years of experience. Her mentorship marks the foundational steps for any island tracker looking to hone their marksmanship and survival skills.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident adventurer trainer--Tai'ree Farsight--left this note for you. You can find her just over yonder near the center of the village. Read the note then seek her out.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The way of the adventurer is fraught with danger, and only those with the keenest senses and quickest reflexes can thrive in the wilds. I look at you and I am reminded of myself when I stood before my mentor, so many years ago. I believe that you have what it takes, but in the end that is up to you alone.
Speak with me again if you wish to take your next steps.
